svg.title: Non-Hispanic White and Black homeownership rates were nearly 30 points apart in 2025, a wider gap than in 2003.
svg.desc: Four small line charts of the homeownership rate from 1994 to 2025, one each for all households, non-Hispanic White, Hispanic and Black householders, on one scale from 40 to 80 percent. In 2025 the rates were 65.2, 74.3, 48.5 and 44.7 percent; the gap between non-Hispanic White and Black households grew from 27.3 points in 2003 to 29.6 in 2025.
